headline: 12 ex-advisers condemn harassment of Prof Yunus at US airport
summary: Former members of the interim government express deep anger over the harassment and threats faced by the Nobel laureate at JFK Airport in New York.
details: Twelve former advisers to the interim government have issued a joint statement strongly condemning the continuous harassment, online propaganda, and physical threats against Nobel laureate Professor Muhammad Yunus.
The advisers stated that the administration led by Professor Yunus worked tirelessly to rebuild a state facing extreme crisis, ending years of economic plunder and human rights violations.

They expressed regret that despite the transfer of power in February 2026, certain political elements continue to spread misleading information and issue physical threats to undermine the interim government's achievements.
The joint statement emphasized that the mandate for reform and dignity achieved through the student-led uprising in July cannot be neutralized by intimidation or personal threats.
The signatories include prominent figures such as economists Dr. Salehuddin Ahmed and Dr. M. Fauzul Kabir Khan, legal experts Asif Nazrul and Adilur Rahman Khan, and filmmaker Mostofa Sarwar Farooki.
The incident occurred on Monday at John F. Kennedy (JFK) Airport in New York, where several unruly individuals attempted to harass Professor Yunus before he was quickly moved away by his companions.
caption:

They expressed regret that despite the transfer of power in February 2026, certain political elements continue to spread misleading information and issue physical threats to undermine the interim government's achievements.

The joint statement emphasized that the mandate for reform and dignity achieved through the student-led uprising in July cannot be neutralized by intimidation or personal threats.

The signatories include prominent figures such as economists Dr. Salehuddin Ahmed and Dr. M. Fauzul Kabir Khan, legal experts Asif Nazrul and Adilur Rahman Khan, and filmmaker Mostofa Sarwar Farooki.

The incident occurred on Monday at John F. Kennedy (JFK) Airport in New York, where several unruly individuals attempted to harass Professor Yunus before he was quickly moved away by his companions.

headline_marked: Former BNP lawmaker [[Salahuddin Ahmed dies]] at Evercare Hospital
headline: Former BNP lawmaker Salahuddin Ahmed dies at Evercare Hospital
summary: The veteran politician served as an MP for Dhaka-4 and Dhaka-5 and was a former General Secretary of the Dhaka Metropolitan BNP.
details: Salahuddin Ahmed, a veteran leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), passed away on Tuesday night at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka.
The former lawmaker served as a Member of Parliament for the undivided Dhaka-4 and Dhaka-5 constituencies in the 1991, 1996 (February), and 2001 national elections.
He was also the former General Secretary of the undivided Dhaka Metropolitan BNP and had been battling age-related illnesses for several years.
In the 2018 national elections, he was seriously injured by a knife attack while protesting against voting irregularities.
His body has been taken to his residence in Shyampur, where the funeral prayer (Janaza) will be held on Wednesday afternoon at the Lal Mosque in the Shyampur-Kadamtali area.
Condolences have been expressed by various political leaders, including BNP's acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi, Mirza Abbas, and Goyeswar Chandra Roy.
caption:
A veteran BNP leader and former MP Salahuddin Ahmed has passed away in Dhaka.

Salahuddin Ahmed, a veteran leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), passed away on Tuesday night at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka.

The former lawmaker served as a Member of Parliament for the undivided Dhaka-4 and Dhaka-5 constituencies in the 1991, 1996 (February), and 2001 national elections.

He was also the former General Secretary of the undivided Dhaka Metropolitan BNP and had been battling age-related illnesses for several years.

In the 2018 national elections, he was seriously injured by a knife attack while protesting against voting irregularities.

His body has been taken to his residence in Shyampur, where the funeral prayer (Janaza) will be held on Wednesday afternoon at the Lal Mosque in the Shyampur-Kadamtali area.

Condolences have been expressed by various political leaders, including BNP's acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi, Mirza Abbas, and Goyeswar Chandra Roy.
